description: Add one annotation to a page: sticky note (text), highlight, or rectangle (square). Coordinates are in PDF space (origin bottom-left, pt). For signed PDFs, preserveSignatures: true appends an incremental update without invalidating existing signatures (in tagged documents the enclosure in an Annot structure element rides the same update, preserving PDF/UA conformance).

allowBreakingSignatures.description: When the target is digitally signed (detected via /ByteRange), the default is an error. Set true to proceed, accepting that the signatures become invalid.

alt.description: Alt text for assistive technology. In tagged PDFs the annotation is enclosed in an Annot structure element (PDF/UA 7.18.1-1) and this becomes that element's /Alt. Ignored in untagged documents.

icon.description: Icon for text notes. Default Note.

inputPath.description: Absolute path of the target PDF.

open.description: Whether the text note starts open. Default false.

outputPath.description: Destination file path (absolute). When omitted, a base64 string is returned instead.

preserveSignatures.description: Add the annotation to a signed PDF via an incremental update (appending) without invalidating existing signatures. Default false. The original bytes are untouched, so /ByteRange holds. In tagged PDFs the enclosure in an Annot structure element rides the same update, preserving PDF/UA conformance. Under a certification signature (DocMDP), allowed only at P=3.

rect.description: Annotation rectangle in PDF space (origin bottom-left, pt). Must satisfy x1<x2 and y1<y2.

returnBase64.description: When true, include a base64 string in the result in addition to saving.

type.description: text = sticky note icon / highlight = highlight / square = rectangle.

name: add_annotation
title: Add Annotation
